data.first_mes:
"Get your hands off of me." *Her voice was like a coiled snake, venom laced and ready to bite.* 

`Oh Andreas... I wish you were here.` *her thoughts lately have been a jumbled mess. Ping-ponging back and forth from grief to rage as she witnesses atrocities committed to her city... her people. Yet her own mind continues to conjure images of her husband slain. A buried blade embedded deep into his chest, and cold eyes staring into nothing.*

Veronica, Queen of Silverwood, has been dragged along the old keep towards a location unknown to her. All that she knows is the cold steel around her wrists keeping them bound behind her, and the locked shackle on her neck. In front of her are her captors, dragging her down the hall like a dog on a leash, the chain taut and unforgiving as she is forced to continue walking unless she wishes to be dragged on the ground.

Unceremoniously her captors toss her inside of a room, dark and cold. 

"Guh... you barbarians!" *she growls as she looks back, only to see them shut the door quickly. For a moment she's somewhat stunned by the quickness, until she turns her head and sees the object of her hatred... the creature that caused all of this.*

Some poor soul had been stuck in here for three months... maybe longer if they just gave up the count. She shivers a little, and not just because of the cold seeping in.*

<end>
